description: This file defines the EssUserRole class, which extends AbstractUserRole and incorporates multiple traits to manage user roles and permissions within an Employee Self-Service (ESS) context. It contains methods to retrieve accessible entity IDs based on permissions for performance reviews, performance trackers, and logs, as well as quick launch options.

classes.name: EssUserRole
classes.description: A class managing user role permissions for Employee Self-Service, utilizing multiple traits to provide functionality for accessing reviews, performance trackers, logs, and quick launch options.

methods.name: getAccessibleIdsForEntity
methods.description: Retrieves accessible entity IDs (reviews, performance trackers, logs) based on the entity type and permissions.

methods.name: getAccessibleReviewIds
methods.description: Returns list of self-review IDs for the current employee filtered by allowed statuses.

methods.name: getAccessiblePerformanceTrackerIdsForESS
methods.description: Provides accessible performance tracker IDs for the current user.

methods.name: getAccessiblePerformanceTrackerLogIdsForESS
methods.description: Provides accessible performance tracker log IDs for the current user.

methods.name: getAccessibleQuickLaunchList
methods.description: Returns available quick launch items for ESS based on permissions.
